info.descriptionme: I am Hamidreza Babazamani, a front-end developer with over 4 years of experience in designing and building responsive websites and applications. I have worked with modern technologies such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, Next.js, as well as Node.js and Express. My goal is to create professional, fast, and user-friendly interfaces that enhance the digital experience for users.
info.title: My Ecperience
info.desc: I’m Hamidreza Babazamani, a front-end developer specialized in JavaScript, React, Next.js, WordPress, and Elementor. I create fast, responsive, and user-friendly websites that deliver exceptional user experiences.
info.myskills: My skills include front-end development using JavaScript, React, and Next.js, designing and developing WordPress websites with Elementor, and optimizing user interfaces for better user experience.

project.description2: Due to the client's specific design preferences, the store theme was fully custom-designed and developed using HTML, Tailwind CSS, and JavaScript. The final template was then integrated into WordPress
project.description3: The website has been custom-built for a client based in Australia using the Next.js framework
project.title4: The cooking tutorial website template is designed and developed using React
project.description4: I designed and developed a website template for a client using React. The template is fully responsive and modern, allowing easy customization to meet the client’s specific needs
project.title5: Coding of the psychology website using Next.js
project.description5: A psychology website was designed and developed for a client based in the UK using the Next.js framework. The site is built to deliver psychology-related content in a user-friendly manner, optimized for fast performance and seamless user experience.
project.description6: The German car repair website has been fully designed and coded, including all pages, as requested by the client.
